content: बिलम् .²1 A hole, cavity, burrow; खनन्नाखुबिलं सिंहः … प्राप्नोति नखभङ्गं हि <ls>Pt. 3. 17</ls>; <ls>R. 12. 5</ls>; <ls>Ms. 10. 49</ls>. .²2 A gap, pit, chasm. .²3 An aperture, opening, outlet. .²4 A cave, hollow. .²5 The hollow of a dish. .²6 The vagina. .{@-लः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of उच्चैःश्रवस्, the horse of Indra. .²2 A sort of cane.
